description: Writes, upgrades and hardens Express 5 (express@5.x, current 5.3) HTTP APIs in Node.js. Covers the path-to-regexp v8 route syntax (named wildcards like /*splat, {/:optional} groups, no ? + ( ) in paths), the silent behaviour changes that break apps without an error (res.send(404) and res.json(obj, 201) now reply 200, res.redirect('back'), req.query getter and "simple" parser, urlencoded extended=false, req.body undefined), async error forwarding, safe JSON error handlers that never leak stack traces, and production defaults (body limits, trust proxy, x-powered-by). Use when adding routes or middleware to an Express app, migrating or bumping express from 4 to 5, fixing "Missing parameter name", "Unexpected ?" or "TypeError: ... is not a function" after an upgrade, writing an Express error handler or 404 handler, or reviewing an Express API for security.
